title: She Who Listens
subtitle: Not a goddess. Something older.
text: Our Lady of Still Waters is not a deity in any conventional sense. She is a force — old and largely passive, analogous to an immune response made vast and slow. She does not intervene. She watches. She speaks in half-heard sounds, in the quality of water at dawn, in the particular silence before a storm. Those deep in purification begin to hear her clearly. She does not guide by command. She guides by attention — making those she watches aware of where they are, and where they are going.
